citations.claim: cart exceeded track limit at first violating step
cart was already near end and moving outward shortly before

explanation: Starting from x=0.5, v=0.5 with light cart (0.5kg), heavy long pole (0.2kg, 1m) and high gravity (12), the state-feedback controller applied only ~0.5N corrective force, prioritizing pole angle (theta ~0.067 rad, well within limits) over cart position. The cart drifted monotonically outward at ~1.3 m/s until it left the +/-2.4m track at step 95.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.405 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The blue cart sits at the far right end of the track through steps 92 to 95 while the pole remains nearly upright. By step 95 the cart reaches the track limit, showing a track exit without the pole falling.
